title.narrative: A GRANT OF FROM GPU BUDGET LINE TO THE OPT HUMANITARIAN FUND, MANAGED BY THE UNITED NATIONS OFFICE FOR THE COORDINATION OF HUMANITARIAN AFFAIRS IN THE

description.narrative: The oPt Humanitarian Fund (HF) plays an important role in supporting the humanitarian response in the oPt. It isdesigned to allocate funds quickly for unexpected emergencies or unforeseen events, in addition to delivering strategicresponses which have been included in the Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) but remain unfunded. In light of theprogressive reduction in the level of funding for the HRP the Humanitarian Fund has become even more vital as a tool tomeet urgent needs. The oPt HF is managed by OCHA on behalf of the Humanitarian Coordinator with the support the Review Board. Inaddition, an Advisory Board provides general policy and strategy guidance on the overall oPt HF process and priorities.Members of the oPt HF Advisory Board include the donors to the fund and representatives of national and internationalNGOs and UN agencies. The main drivers of humanitarian vulnerability in the oPt remain unchanged. The protractedoccupation, is accompanied by the systematic denial of Palestinian human rightsand continuing conflict. Humanitarian needs throughout the oPt remain extensive, particularly in the Gaza Strip.Following the Hamas attacks on Israel on October 7 and Israel’s full scale retaliation, over 2 million people in the oPT aresuffering a severe humanitarian crisis. The UN Agencies responsible for their assistance have been chronicallyunderfunded for some time and now require rapid and significant assistance to meet immediate humanitarian andservice needs.
